packageCheck.note: Only budget failures reported; thresholds unchanged. This is local preview validation, not release readiness.

checks: Tabs: task checkbox updates overview from 1/3 to 2/3; Home/End and rapid tab changes work; one tabpanel and no duplicate IDs.
CommandSearch: open focuses input, End scrolls final item into view, Enter toggles notifications or creates a local document, unmatched query removes aria-activedescendant and shows empty message.
CommandSearch: local Ctrl+K opens the panel; close button and reopening work; English dialog has localized close label.
SelectOption: keyboard End scrolls final item into view, Enter selects, reopening focuses selection, Escape returns to trigger. Disabled/enabled toggle verified.
Chinese/English, blue/purple/black controls, explicit motion none and runtime prefers-reduced-motion verified for all three previews.
390px viewport and narrow select fit without horizontal overflow; command dialog is 337px wide with no internal horizontal overflow.
Final reload produced no new warning/error log; one earlier HMR dependency-array error is historical.
Command modal Tab traps focus between input and close button; Escape from close button closes modal and restores trigger focus.
limitations: With search input focused, Escape did not close the modal in current Chrome; with close button focused, Escape did close and restore focus. Full-preview simulated Escape passes 3 cycles and IME guard. Cause not established; do not count input-focused browser Escape as passed.

scopeNote: Enhances existing SelectOption, TabBar/TabsContent and CommandSearch/Modal. No new public component or navigation category. User accepted batch 3 on 2026-10-14. Acceptance does not resolve the recorded input-focused Escape browser limitation or package budget failures.
